name: What is the process for starting a home renovation project with your company?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a home renovation project with your company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we provide a detailed proposal and design concepts. Once approved, we establish a project timeline and commence work, managing all aspects from material procurement to construction. Regular communication ensures you are informed throughout every stage until project completion and final walkthrough.
